data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaturthi', which translates to 'fourth'. In Hindu mythology, Choto is a term used to refer to the younger sister or the younger one in general. The name Choto carries the meaning “Little, Young One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Choto usually hope their child will grow to embody little, young one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
